entities.summary: Stony Blyden (b. 1993-03-09, Reykjavík) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Reykjavík and Iceland. Known in the fields of iceland, composers & musicians, europe.
